reconstructed_theorem_text: For every normed additive commutative group E with a real inner-product structure and every real kappa, phaseCost kappa maps an ordered pair of phase points z1,z2 in E times E to ENNReal.ofReal of (1/(2kappa)+1/2) times the squared norm of the position displacement, plus the real inner product of position and momentum displacements, plus the squared norm of the momentum displacement. The definition is total for all real kappa; no positivity or measurability hypothesis is imposed.
objects: A real inner-product space E, real kappa, and two points of E times E.
domains: The definition is total for every real kappa; its paper-metric interpretation is restricted later.
quantifiers: Universal E and kappa, then every ordered pair of phase points.
assumptions: Only normed additive and real inner-product structure is needed to define the totalized cost.
conclusion: ENNReal.ofReal of the exact expanded block-matrix quadratic form.
scopes: No metric axioms, transport estimate, optimizer, or dynamics.
constant_dependencies: The same coefficient; the two halves combine into one inner product.
